name: ensemble
description: Desktop workspace for orchestrating coding agents

scripts.test:runtime: uv run --project services/runtime --extra dev --locked --python 3.12.3 pytest -q services/runtime/tests runners/mock runners/pi
scripts.dev: echo "Run: pnpm dev:runtime (terminal A) && pnpm dev:canvas (terminal B)"
scripts.quality:scripts:test: node --test scripts/quality/*.test.mjs && uv run --project services/runtime --extra dev --locked --python 3.12.3 python -m unittest scripts.quality.test_python_boundaries scripts.quality.test_validate_config
scripts.quality:frontend: pnpm lint:canvas && pnpm typecheck:canvas && pnpm test:canvas && pnpm build:canvas
scripts.quality:rust:runtime: cargo fmt --manifest-path crates/ensemble-runtime/Cargo.toml --check && cargo clippy --manifest-path crates/ensemble-runtime/Cargo.toml --locked --lib --bins --all-features -- -D warnings -D clippy::unwrap_used -D clippy::await_holding_lock -D clippy::undocumented_unsafe_blocks && cargo clippy --manifest-path crates/ensemble-runtime/Cargo.toml --locked --all-targets --all-features -- -D warnings -D clippy::await_holding_lock -D clippy::undocumented_unsafe_blocks && cargo test --manifest-path crates/ensemble-runtime/Cargo.toml --locked --all-features
scripts.quality:rust:tauri:check: cargo fmt --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml --check && cargo clippy --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml --locked --lib --bins --all-features -- -D warnings -D clippy::unwrap_used -D clippy::await_holding_lock -D clippy::undocumented_unsafe_blocks && cargo clippy --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml --locked --all-targets --all-features -- -D warnings -D clippy::await_holding_lock -D clippy::undocumented_unsafe_blocks && cargo test --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml --locked --all-features
scripts.quality: pnpm quality:scripts:test && pnpm quality:hygiene && pnpm quality:config && pnpm quality:shape && pnpm quality:boundaries && pnpm quality:boundaries:python && pnpm quality:boundaries:rust && pnpm quality:links && pnpm quality:format && pnpm quality:frontend && pnpm quality:python && pnpm quality:rust:runtime && pnpm quality:rust:tauri:check
scripts.quality:python: uv sync --project services/runtime --extra dev --locked --python 3.12.3 && uv run --project services/runtime --extra dev --locked --python 3.12.3 ruff check services/runtime/ensemble_runtime services/runtime/tests && uv run --project services/runtime --extra dev --locked --python 3.12.3 ruff --config services/runtime/pyproject.toml check runners scripts/quality && uv run --project services/runtime --extra dev --locked --python 3.12.3 ruff format --check services/runtime/ensemble_runtime services/runtime/tests && uv run --project services/runtime --extra dev --locked --python 3.12.3 ruff --config services/runtime/pyproject.toml format --check runners scripts/quality && uv run --project services/runtime --extra dev --locked --python 3.12.3 pytest -q services/runtime/tests runners/mock runners/pi
scripts.quality:config: uv run --project services/runtime --extra dev --locked --python 3.12.3 python scripts/quality/validate_config.py
scripts.quality:boundaries:python: uv run --project services/runtime --extra dev --locked --python 3.12.3 python scripts/quality/python_boundaries.py
